text:
harper: Heads-up: I opened a docs PR to add a 'tenant affinity with autoscale' how-to for Dedicated capacity. Includes YAML, terraform snippet, and a concise python SDK example. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4120

harper: Main goals: 1) show how tenant_selector interacts with autoscale policies (cooldown, burst window), 2) migration note for teams on older reserved_pool usage, 3) one-liner monitoring query for dedicated.pool.utilization.

li: Thanks — can we also show an explicit failure-mode note: what happens when affinity prevents placement? People expect instant fallback but we actually queue / apply burst from shared capacity.

rowan: Agreed. Add a short bullet: "If affinity can't be satisfied, routing may fallback to compatible pools per fallback policy; this can increase latency and consume burst credits."

harper: Added that bullet and a tiny example fallback policy yaml.

li: For terraform snippet, name the resource redwood_dedicated_pool not dedicated_pool to match the provider. Small but reduces copy/paste errors.

harper: Fixed terraform resource name. Also standardized the label name to tenant_selector (not tenant_label) across all examples.

docs-bot: PR #4120 opened by harper 12 review requested @li @rowan (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4120)

rowan: Quick nit: your SLA wording says "SLA exceptions may occur" which legal flagged as vague. Legal, could you propose a brief replacement?

legal: Suggest: "SLA obligations for latency are preserved for hard-isolated pools; soft affinity may result in increased latency during placement or preemption events." Keeps it actionable.

harper: Updated copy with legal suggestion.

li: Could we include a tiny verification curl for the control-plane response showing placement=dedicated and placement=shared? e.g., curl -XPOST /v1/provision -d @example.json | jq .placement

harper: Included the curl and sample outputs (placement: "dedicated" when matched, placement: "shared-burst" when not matched).

rowan: One more ask: add a monitoring snippet that shows a 5m rolling window for dedicated.pool.utilization and an alert example. That helps ops runbooks.

harper: Added a PromQL snippet and a sample alert rule (threshold 85% for 10m). Also referenced metric-glossary link. I fixed a broken anchor while I was there.

li: LGTM besides a tiny grammar tweak in the migration note: change "map reserved_pool -> dedicated_pool" to "map reserved_pool to dedicated_pool".

harper: Fixed grammar and pushed.

ci-bot: docs CI: build succeeded for PR #4120 14 staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/tenant-affinity-autoscale

rowan: Merging after CI green. Can someone follow up with a short entry in examples/CHANGELOG.md listing the new snippets?

harper: Filed docs ticket D-789 to add changelog entry and a terraform quickstart later.

li: I'll add a tiny unit test that lints snippets for correct metric names in a follow-up PR.

harper: Thanks for the reviews and the legal sign-off. Merging now :shipit:

rowan: Nice one. This'll help a few customers migrating from older reserved pools.

harper: Thread closed. Thanks!
